evidence: Seventeen standard-library tests exercise valid, invalid, bypass, expiry, and recovery transitions
The skill validator accepts the revised skill and actionlint accepts the repository workflow
The guard reports this repository transition with exact deltas and a stable failure fingerprint
last_decision.force: Long-running agentic development needs a deterministic promotion gate in addition to prompt guidance
last_decision.owner: The five-step-engineering repository owns the guard, policy, action, and release lifecycle
last_decision.removal_or_review_condition: Review on a major guard release or when evidence shows the invariant causes systematic false decisions
last_decision.simplest_rejected_alternative: Prompt-only review cannot enforce a transition invariant or produce a stable machine-readable failure
last_decision.target: Prevent observable unearned structural growth from entering protected branches
